scenario.geometry_role: Existing native 535 fanout-curve candidate; ordinary roads and complete legal movement permissions unchanged.

scenario.lane_intention_assumptions: One moving lane waypoint 7.5 m before the assigned detector road ends; native lane choice elsewhere. Short single-lane sections need no waypoint.
